profile.headline: Software Engineer
profile.summary: I am a Software Developer with experience in building multi-tiered and Microservice applications. Created dynamic front-end applications with Typescript/JavaScript, Angular, and Bootstrap. Integrated service-side technologies such as PostgreSQL, free and open-source Relational Database Management System and connections using JDBC, while running on Apache's Tomcat servers.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Skills: IT Operations · Linux · Network Architecture · C# · Python (Programming Language) · Web Development

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
Languages:
	BootStrap, Java, TypeScript, HTML 5, CSS, JavaScript, Angular, C#, Python 

DevOps:
	Linux, Git, Maven, NodeJS Package Manager (NPM), Docker Hub, SonarCloud 

Database Layers:
	PostgresQL, JDBC, Hibernate, AWS RDS (Relational Database), AWS EC2 (Elastic Compute Cloud), 
	MSSQL, Java H2 

Java Web:
	Servlet API, Apache Tomcat, Jackson Object Mapper, AWS (Amazon Web Services), REST, JSON

Testing:
	Postman, Mockito, Jenkins, Angular Test (Karma), Angular Test (Jasmine), JUnit 

Micro Services:
	Spring Boot, Spring Data, Spring AOP, Spring Framework, Spring MVC, Spring ORM
